name: Ki USA Corporation
old_description: Our goal is to be a world class organization; through teamwork and communication, success is our future.  We specialize in manufacturing custom automotive parts and components for notable customers like Honda, Mazda, and Ford.  Our advanced metal stamping, electro-coat painting, and welding processes enable us to create the perfect solution for your company's needs.
about:
Ki USA Corporation has operated from Berea, Kentucky since 1989 as a subsidiary of American Industrial Acquisition Corporation. The company began as a manufacturer of automotive engine, body, and suspension components.

The firm specializes in precision metal stamping, robotic welding, and electro-coat finishing, delivering products such as engine mounts, brake boosters, and oil pans. Its 250,000-square-foot Kentucky facility on 54 acres employs about 160 associates, while a subsidiary in Irapuato, Mexico adds 45 employees and 3,288 square meters of production space. The vertically integrated platform combines stamping, welding, and e-coat under one roof, supported by programmable robotic welding systems and automated material handling.

Ki USA primarily serves the automotive industry, supplying Honda, Mazda, and Ford for internal combustion, hybrid, and electric vehicle platforms. It is expanding into power generation and home appliance sectors, leveraging its high-volume automotive and industrial production capabilities.

The company emphasizes trust, transparency, and continuous improvement, with an in-house e-coat line that ensures faster turnaround and strict quality control. Community involvement includes support for Relay For Life and Soles4Souls.
